name: Frame Edge Energy
algorithm: Frame Edge Energy — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes frame-level edge energy distribution for video deepfake detection:

1. **边缘Energy计算**: Per frame, edge energy is computed using Sobel/Canny operators: E_edge = Σ(|∇I|²) over the frame. The spatial distribution of edge energy is mapped, revealing where visual detail and boundaries are concentrated.

2. **人脸-Background边缘EnergyRatio**: In authentic video, the edge energy density in face regions vs. background follows a consistent ratio determined by the imaging pipeline. Deepfake composites may show different edge energy characteristics between the generated face (from one rendering pipeline) and the original background.

3. **时间边缘Energy分析**: Total frame edge energy is tracked over time. Natural video shows smooth edge energy variation corresponding to motion and scene changes. Deepfake generation may produce frame-to-frame edge energy fluctuations — particularly in face regions where the generator's ability to reproduce edge detail varies with head pose and expression.

4. **边缘频率分布**: The distribution of edge magnitudes per frame is analyzed. Natural edge magnitude distributions follow power-law statistics. AI-generated content may produce different edge magnitude distributions — often lacking the heavy tail of strong edges or showing excess medium-strength edges from the generator's activation functions.

5. **Multi-Directional边缘Energy**: Edge energy is decomposed by direction (horizontal, vertical, diagonal). Natural scenes show direction-dependent edge energy distributions (buildings have strong horizontal/vertical edges). AI-generated content may show unnatural directional edge energy, particularly checkerboard-like patterns from transposed convolution artifacts in the generator.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through frame edge energy analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
